statement.p: The figure below shows a function g(x) and its tangent line at the point B = (5.4,4.4). If the point A on the tangent line is (5.33,4.38), fill in the blanks below to complete the statements about the function g at the point B.

description.p: Graph of a sharply concave down function with a steep initial slope, bending down as the x-values increase. The point B is on the curve near the initial bend, the tangent line extends through B, and the point A is on the tangent line to the left of B.

solution.p: Since the point B=(5.4,4.4) is on the graph of g, we have g(5.4)=4.4. The slope of the tangent line touching the graph at x=2 is given by \mbox{slope} = \frac{\mbox{rise}}{\mbox{run}} = \frac{4.4-4.38}{5.4-5.33} = 0.286. Thus, g'(5.4)=0.286.
